name: Friday Night Funkin'
description:
The base game, shipped as the required global content pack.
Weeks 1 to 7 and Weekend 1: their songs, charts, characters, stages and cutscenes.
Stages are scripted classes under scripts/classes/stages/, so nothing here needs the engine to know about it.
It stays outside the app binary, but the engine loads it as part of its base content when present.
